sourceCollectionId.description: Should be provided if #archiveContent, #collectStats, or #archiveErrors is set to true.

chunkContent.description:
If set then it will chunk content to the chunkSize specified in the annotation on #source type.
{@see Ann.DataLoad#chunkSize}

collectStats.description:
If set then stats will be persisted in {@link SourceFile} or in {@link SourceCollection#statsUrl}.
Errors will not be persisted in SourceFile either.
Please provide #sourceCollectionId

archiveContent.description:
If set then source content will not be persisted in {@link SourceCollection#completedContentUrl}
on completion.

archiveErrors.description:
If set then if source content failed during processing or parsing, content will be persisted
in {@link SourceCollection#rejectedContentUrl} / {@link SourceCollection#failedContentUrl}.
Also serailized {@link FailedSource} will be written to failedSourcesUrl

deferred.description:
If set to true then
1) #chunkContent is false
2) #collectStats is false
3) #archiveContent is false
4) #archiveErrors is false
5) processing of content is synchronous

async.description: Determines whether the process returns immediately or not.

readMetadataOnly.description: Generates the SourceContentMeta for the source content before processing(data-loading) begins.

sourceContentUrl.description: Prefix to specify for a process, could be a prefix with content url.

chunkId.description: chunkId for a process, could be batchId.

meta.description: Meta information for the processing of the sources

title:
Spec for processing (data-loading) source content/objs into the C3 type system.
used in {@link Source#process}
name: SourceProcessSpec
